series.title: Integration, assessment and remediation
covers: Making and responding to offers from a family member, a friend…
Inviting and responding to invitations from a family member, a friend…
Talking about one's family members, friends…
Explaining sequence of actions in a process using sequencers (first, then…)
Talking about one's, a friend's, a neighbor's… experience and past actions
Talking about concurrent activities

items.title: Write
items.text: Write two sentences about what your family members were doing at 8 p.m. yesterday.
items.solution: At 8 p.m. my father was watching the news while my mother was preparing dinner.

items.title: Possessive 's
items.text: Rewrite using 's: the car of my father – the room of Ali.
items.solution: my father's car – Ali's room

items.title: Let's
items.text: Make suggestions with Let's / Why don't we: (play football) (go to the library)
items.solution: Let's play football. – Why don't we go to the library?

items.title: Sequencers
items.text: Put the steps in order with first, then, after that, finally: make tea – boil water – put tea and sugar – pour.
items.solution: First, boil water. Then, put tea and sugar. After that, make the tea. Finally, pour it into glasses.

items.title: Write
items.text: Write a short dialogue (4 lines) where you offer help to a neighbour.
items.solution: A: Good morning, Mrs. Diallo. Can I help you with your bags? B: Oh, yes please. A: Here you are. B: Thank you very much.

items.title: Complete
items.text: Complete with sequencers: ___, open the computer. ___, type your password. ___, open the program.
items.solution: First – Then/Next – Finally

items.title: Questions
items.text: Write questions for the answers: a) She is a nurse. b) He lives in Zouérate. c) They have got three children.
items.solution: a) What does she do? b) Where does he live? c) How many children have they got?

items.title: Offers
items.text: Make offers: (carry your bag) (a cup of tea)
items.solution: Shall I carry your bag? / Let me carry your bag. – Would you like a cup of tea?

items.title: Past continuous
items.text: Complete: When the teacher came in, the pupils ___ (talk).
items.solution: were talking

items.title: Describe
items.text: Write 5 sentences about a member of your family (name, age, job, character, hobbies).
items.solution: My uncle is Mohamed. He is 40. He is a farmer. He is generous and patient. He likes reading.

items.title: Dialogue
items.text:
Complete:
Mother: I'm very tired.
Son: ___ I help you with the dishes?
Mother: Yes, ___ . Thank you, dear.
items.solution: Shall/Can ; please

items.title: Reading
items.text:
Read: «My best friend is Aminetou. We are in the same class. She is very clever and always helps me in maths.»
a) Who is Aminetou? b) How does she help the writer?
items.solution: a) The writer's best friend / classmate. b) She helps her in maths.

items.title: Questions
items.text: Ask questions in the past: (you – travel – last year) (where – he – go)
items.solution: Did you travel last year? – Where did he go?

items.title: Accept / decline
items.text: Accept and decline: «Would you like to come to the beach with us?»
items.solution: I'd love to. Thank you! — I'm sorry, I can't. I have to study.

items.title: While
items.text: Join with while: I was reading. My sister was cooking.
items.solution: I was reading while my sister was cooking.

items.title: Past simple
items.text: Complete with the past simple: Yesterday I ___ (go) to the market. I ___ (buy) some fruit. I ___ (not see) my friend.
items.solution: went – bought – didn't see

items.title: Invitation card
items.text: Write a short invitation card for your Eid lunch.
items.solution: Dear Sidi, I'd like to invite you to lunch at my house on Eid day at 1 p.m. I hope you can come. Your friend, …

items.title: Invite
items.text: Invite a friend: (to your birthday party – on Friday)
items.solution: Would you like to come to my birthday party on Friday?

items.title: Last holiday
items.text: Write 5 sentences about your last holiday.
items.solution: Last summer I went to my village. I visited my grandparents. I helped them. I played with my cousins. I enjoyed it a lot.

items.title: Recipe
items.text: Write 4 steps to wash your hands.
items.solution: First, wet your hands. Then, put soap. After that, rub your hands for 20 seconds. Finally, rinse and dry them.

items.title: Going to
items.text: Complete with going to: I ___ (study) medicine. They ___ (visit) Nouadhibou next week.
items.solution: am going to study – are going to visit

items.title: Likelihood
items.text: Complete with will probably / may / won't: It ___ rain tomorrow (50%). Our team ___ win (90%).
items.solution: may – will probably

items.title: Write
items.text: Compare three members of your family using superlatives.
items.solution: My grandfather is the oldest. My brother is the tallest. My little sister is the funniest.

items.title: Superlatives
items.text: Write the superlative: tall – big – happy – important – good – bad.
items.solution: the tallest – the biggest – the happiest – the most important – the best – the worst

items.title: Correct
items.text: Correct: «She is the more clever girl in the class.» «It's the most hot day.»
items.solution: She is the cleverest girl in the class. It's the hottest day.

items.title: My future
items.text: Write 5 sentences about your future plans.
items.solution: I'm going to finish my studies. I want to be an engineer. I'm going to work in Mauritania. I'll help my family. I'll travel abroad.

items.title: Situation
items.text: Your mother is worried about your marks. Write two promises to her.
items.solution: I promise I'll revise every day. I won't play video games before finishing my homework.

items.title: Mauritania
items.text: Complete: Nouakchott is ___ (large) city in Mauritania. Kediet ej Jill is ___ (high) mountain in Mauritania.
items.solution: the largest – the highest

items.title: Promises
items.text: Make promises with will: (study harder) (not be late)
items.solution: I will study harder. – I won't be late.

items.title: Questions
items.text: Ask about intentions: (you – do – after school)
items.solution: What are you going to do after school?

items.text: Accept and refuse politely: «Would you like some juice?»
items.solution: Yes, please. That's kind of you. — No, thank you. I'm fine.

items.solution: were talking

items.title: Present perfect
items.text: Complete: I ___ (never/visit) Chinguetti. ___ you ever ___ (eat) camel meat?
items.solution: have never visited – Have / eaten

Complete with going to: I ___ (study) medicine. They ___ (visit) Nouadhibou next week.

Exercise 2 : Situation
Your mother is worried about your marks. Write two promises to her.

Exercise 3 : Mauritania
Complete: Nouakchott is ___ (large) city in Mauritania. Kediet ej Jill is ___ (high) mountain in Mauritania.
items.solution:
Exercise 1
am going to study – are going to visit

Exercise 2
I promise I'll revise every day. I won't play video games before finishing my homework.

Exercise 3
the largest – the highest

items.title: Proposal 15 — Term 3 exam
items.text:
Exercise 1 : Questions
Ask about intentions: (you – do – after school)

Exercise 2 : Likelihood
Complete with will probably / may / won't: It ___ rain tomorrow (50%). Our team ___ win (90%).

Exercise 3 : Correct
Correct: «She is the more clever girl in the class.» «It's the most hot day.»
items.solution:
Exercise 1
What are you going to do after school?

Exercise 2
may – will probably

Exercise 3

items.title: Proposal 17 — Term 3 exam
items.text:
Exercise 1 : My future
Write 5 sentences about your future plans.

Exercise 2 : Situation
Your mother is worried about your marks. Write two promises to her.

Exercise 3 : Mauritania
Complete: Nouakchott is ___ (large) city in Mauritania. Kediet ej Jill is ___ (high) mountain in Mauritania.
items.solution:
Exercise 1
I'm going to finish my studies. I want to be an engineer. I'm going to work in Mauritania. I'll help my family. I'll travel abroad.

Exercise 2
I promise I'll revise every day. I won't play video games before finishing my homework.
